@fig-prisma adds the [selection rubric](rubric.qmd) to the recorded screening.
Group selection reconsidered all 51 candidates, including papers outside the
migration and language section.

```{r}
#| label: fig-prisma

A separate group selection reconsidered all 51 using eligibility, relevance, citations, journal prestige as a research-quality proxy, sample size and topic coverage. Ten papers were recommended provisionally; 41 other candidates include reserves, background and unresolved cases."
